provenance_note: From a multi-sign interior wayfinding package. All client, vendor, designer, building/department/room/person names, street address, project numbers, and the ADA-assistance phone number excluded at extraction. Higher-education vertical retained. Destination copy excluded; copy structure retained.

program_model.instance_model: a directional/directory design produced as several coded sizes (medium/large directional, freestanding directional) with destination lists set as full-size art by the designer; deployed at decision points

knowledge.plain_language_summary: A built-up acrylic interior directional/directory: a painted acrylic panel carrying a direct-printed list of destinations with directional arrows, grouped under a department or building header, finished with a non-glare ADA clear coat. Deployed at decision points as wall-mounted directories and, in a freestanding variant, as a standing directional.
knowledge.rationale: Direct-print destination lists let a directory carry many lines and be revised by reprinting the panel art, while the built-up acrylic body matches the rest of the interior sign family.
knowledge.tradeoffs: Direct-print panels are flexible and low-cost to revise but are not individually changeable line-by-line; a full reprint is needed when the directory changes.
knowledge.when_to_use: Decision points in an interior wayfinding system that need a grouped destination list with directional arrows.

structure.construction: built-up/laminated acrylic panel, front and edges painted, direct-print destination list and arrows; layouts provided full-size by designer
clear non-glare medium matte acrylic over the printed field

materials_manifest.product: Clear P95 non-glare medium matte acrylic sheet
Matthews MP00959 Amsterdam Blue (department color), satin
Matthews (MAP) SOA 4158SP ADA non-glare clear coat

dimensions.note: Coded medium/large directional sizes plus a freestanding directional variant; full-size art supplied by designer, sizes flexible.

copy_blocks.treatment: standard footer line with assistance contact

compliance.notes: Non-glare matte surface and ADA non-glare clear coat. A directory footer carries an ADA-assistance contact line; the contact value is excluded as PII.

rules_observations: Destinations grouped under a header with consistent arrow placement supports information sequencing at decision points.
Shared built-up acrylic body, type, and department color hold family consistency with the rest of the program.
craft_observations: Direct-print on a non-glare matte field keeps a dense directory legible and revisable by reprinting rather than refabricating.

aesthetic_notes.note: Utility-first directory; the discipline is in consistent grouping and arrow logic, not ornament.

open_items: Freestanding directional variant uses a different mounting and would be split into its own record in full production
Final sizes/layouts designer-supplied, not fixed on this set

extraction_meta.field_confidence: high on construction and finishes; sizes/layouts designer-supplied
modeling_notes: Record covers wall-mounted directories (mounting:wall_mounted); a freestanding directional variant in the same package has a different mounting and is flagged for its own record in full production rather than collapsed here.
